prologue.zh: 洪武十九年，东海未靖。汤和奉命巡海，筑宁村所，列五十九城。
prologue.en: In the nineteenth year of Hongwu, the eastern sea was still unsettled. Tang He inspected the coast, built Ningcun garrison, and linked fifty-nine coastal posts.
prologue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__抵御倭患第一人+汤和(1)(1).txt:6

prologue.zh: 海防不能只靠官军。寓兵于民，所城才守得久。
prologue.en: Coastal defence cannot rest on soldiers alone. Let the people share the watch, and the garrison will endure.
prologue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/意绘抗倭英雄汤和-漫画全文.txt:706

prologue.zh: 先点望海灯。灯照到的地方，乡勇才知道该往哪里聚。
prologue.en: Light the sea-watch lamp first. Where its light reaches, the militia will know where to gather.
prologue.source_ref: 游戏化交互；制度依据见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__抵御倭患第一人+汤和(1)(1).txt:6

prologue.zh: 再定所城界桩。城不必大，水道、马道、烽堠要彼此接应。
prologue.en: Next set the garrison boundary. The fort need not be large, but its waterways, horse roads, and beacon posts must answer one another.
prologue.source_ref: 制度依据见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:15038

prologue.zh: 最后立乡兵旗。农时种田，警时执械；旗一响，各家都要应。
prologue.en: Finally raise the militia banner. Farm in peace, take up arms in alarm; when the banner sounds, every household answers.
prologue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/意绘抗倭英雄汤和-漫画全文.txt:706

prologue.zh: 洪武二十年，宁村所城成。汤和布下的不是一座孤城，是一张海防的网。
prologue.en: In the twentieth year of Hongwu, Ningcun garrison was completed. Tang He had laid not one isolated fort, but a net across the coast.
prologue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__抵御倭患第一人+汤和(1)(1).txt:6

main_intro.zh: 嘉靖三十七年四月十九日，王德为解温州府城之围，移师宁村策应。
main_intro.en: On the nineteenth day of the fourth month, 1558, Wang De moved his troops to Ningcun to relieve the siege of Wenzhou.
main_intro.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:13760

main_intro.zh: 次日，王德从宁村方向驰援，在金岙遭伏殉国。
main_intro.en: The next day Wang De rode out from Ningcun and was ambushed and killed at Jin'ao.
main_intro.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:16301

main_intro.zh: 王沛、王德死后，王氏筑永昌堡。嘉靖三十八年，堡成。
main_intro.en: After Wang Pei and Wang De died, the Wang clan built Yongchang Fort. It was completed in 1559.
main_intro.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:283

main_intro.zh: 我叫王陆，乳名阿六。今夜，我是城外最后一盏灯。
main_intro.en: I am Wang Lu, called A-Liu at home. Tonight I am the last lamp outside the fort.
main_intro.source_ref: 虚构守灯乡勇，代表嘉靖三十八年守堡民众；堡史见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:283-306

field_notes.zh: 汤和筑宁村所在前，王氏筑永昌堡在后。两座城隔着百七十年，共用同一条海防线。
field_notes.en: Tang He built Ningcun garrison first; the Wang clan built Yongchang Fort generations later. Two walls, one coastal line.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/堡与汤和关系索引.md:5

field_notes.zh: 堡成那年，五色龙灯第一次绕城。纸鳞下没有神兵，只有一排排不肯熄的灯。
field_notes.en: In the year the fort was finished, the five-colour dragon lantern first circled the wall. Beneath the paper scales were no gods, only lamps refusing to go out.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/汤和信俗(11.18)__龙湾汤和信俗文化节启幕在即 拼字龙灯邀您共同祈愿“天下太平”(3)(1).txt:3

field_notes.zh: 潮声里有人摸上滩涂。灯不能灭，灭了就分不清乡勇和倭寇。
field_notes.en: Someone is crawling up the tidal flats under the surf. The lamp must not go out, or I cannot tell militia from raiders.
field_notes.source_ref: 滩涂夜袭为游戏情境；永昌堡抗倭背景见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:279-306

field_notes.zh: 灯油只剩这些。亮一点，看得远，也把更多刀引过来。
field_notes.en: This is all the oil left. A brighter flame sees farther, and draws more blades.
field_notes.source_ref: 灯火风险收益为玩法设计；望楼灯民俗见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:279

field_notes.zh: 五色龙鳞是龙灯会的旧例。集齐五色，老人说能拼出“天下太平”。
field_notes.en: Five-coloured dragon scales follow the old lantern-fair custom. With all five, the elders say the lanterns can spell 'peace under heaven'.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__龙湾汤和信俗文化节启幕在即 拼字龙灯邀您共同祈愿“天下太平”(3)(1).txt:3

field_notes.zh: 油快尽了。摸黑能多换几分军功，可身边的人也会更快倒下。
field_notes.en: The oil is nearly gone. Fighting in darkness earns more merit, but comrades fall faster.
field_notes.source_ref: 灯火风险收益为玩法设计；不以虚构台词替代史料

field_notes.zh: 夜将尽。滩涂尽头，大名先锋的火铳已经排开。
field_notes.en: The night is almost over. At the edge of the flats, the Daimyo's gunners have formed their line.
field_notes.source_ref: 游戏情境；倭寇火器与围城背景见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:279-312

field_notes.zh: 守住这一阵。天亮之前，永昌堡不能熄灯。
field_notes.en: Hold this line. Before dawn, the lamps of Yongchang must not go out.
field_notes.source_ref: 永昌堡守城背景见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:283-312

field_notes.zh: 百家宴的灶火还没灭。一家端一碗，守城的人就还能再撑一阵。
field_notes.en: The hundred-family feast stove still burns. One bowl from each home, and the defenders can hold another watch.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/堡与汤和关系索引.md:6

field_notes.zh: 七月十五的灯是给亡魂照路的。守夜人把王沛、王德的名字写在灯纸上，不敢写错一笔。
field_notes.en: Lamps on the fifteenth of the seventh month light the dead's road. Keepers write Wang Pei and Wang De on the paper, afraid of one wrong stroke.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/汤和信俗(11.18)__抵御倭患第一人+汤和(1)(1).txt:17

field_notes.zh: 汤和庙的钟声穿过海雾。天边泛白，城墙上的人终于敢把刀放下。
field_notes.en: The bell of the Tang He temple crosses the sea fog. The horizon pales, and the defenders dare to lower their blades.
field_notes.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/汤和信俗(11.18)__汤和庙基地介绍.txt:4

epilogue.zh: 天亮了。永昌堡的灯从嘉靖三十八年，一直传到今天。
epilogue.en: Dawn came. The lamps of Yongchang have passed from 1559 to this day.
epilogue.source_ref: 永昌堡筑成于嘉靖三十八年，见 docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:283-306

epilogue.zh: 2026 年，汤和诞辰七百周年。五支龙灯队拼出“天下太平”。
epilogue.en: In 2026, the seven-hundredth anniversary of Tang He's birth, five dragon-lantern teams spell out 'peace under heaven'.
epilogue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__龙湾汤和信俗文化节启幕在即 拼字龙灯邀您共同祈愿“天下太平”(3)(1).txt:3

epilogue.zh: 汤和布网，王德过桥，王叔杲筑堡，守灯人点灯。
epilogue.en: Tang He cast the net, Wang De crossed the bridge, Wang Shugao built the fort, and the lamp-watch lit the flame.
epilogue.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/堡与汤和关系索引.md:1
